name: Sonia
source:
It's a short game where you are a guy that wakes up in a cave and meets a ghost. Why are you here ? Is this only a dream or is it more real than what it seems ?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/sonia/130238]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
这是一款简短的游戏，你是一个在洞穴中醒来并遇到鬼魂的人。你为什么在这里？这只是一个梦还是它比看起来更真实？

[来自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/sonia/130238]GameJolt[/url]]
